summary: Iteration 20: tested the courier-incident banner on order cards and the live incident toast. Backend: 6/6 pytest passed. POST /courier/orders/{id}/incident returns {ok, incident}, the note is trimmed, bad type/note give 422 and an owner token is rejected. Incidents appear in /orders?active=true, /dashboard recent and /biz/orders. Code check confirms the notify links: owner /order/{id}, business /biz-order/{id}. Frontend at 375x667, all flows pass. Owner Inicio and Órdenes cards show incident-banner-{n} with the latest label, '(+N)', HH:mm, courier name and note. A card without incidents shows no banner. The business /biz cards show the same banner. A live incident shows the toast '⚠️ Incidencia #N · Carlos Gómez: label — note' in about 5-6s, for the owner both on the tabs and on the /order/{id} detail screen, and for the business on /biz. The fee/charge boxes still render and tapping a card opens /order/{id} or /biz-order/{id}. No console errors. No deprecated expo packages.

minor.issue: In the preview env the push service returns 401, so the backend logs 'EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY missing or invalid'. It does not block requests, but real push notifications for incidents cannot be checked here.

integration_issues.issue: The toast comes from the layout watcher (10s), but the Órdenes and Inicio lists use other queries that refetch every 15s. So for up to ~15s after the toast, the card does not show the new banner yet. Seen: banner-1552 missing 1.5s after the toast, present on reload. Fix: when useIncidentAlert finds a new incident, call invalidateQueries for ['orders'] and ['dashboard'].

action_items: Optional: in useIncidentAlert (owner), invalidate the ['orders'] and ['dashboard'] queries when a new incident is found, so the card banner updates together with the toast.
critical_code_review_comments: useIncidentAlert only alerts for orders seen in a previous poll. An order that first appears with incidents already counts as new (prev 0) and will ring. That is fine.

The owner watcher lives in the (owner) layout. It keeps polling when /order/{id} is pushed on top (verified). It will not run if the app is cold-opened straight to a non-owner-group route via deep link.
/dashboard recent is limited to 8 active orders, so Inicio cards past 8 will not show banners. The Órdenes tab covers that.
